endorsements.name: Cat Okita
endorsements.label: Aura: A Peer To Peer Reputation System
endorsements.description: Aura is a peer-to-peer reputation system designed to create localized reputation information linked to specific users and/or systems. It can also function as a carrier of information in the form of 'recommendations'. Current research in trust metrics and reputation systems will be briefly covered, and implementation and design challenges will be discussed in greater depth.
